spec.prompt: Close-up detail of a white Berkut spacesuit in vacuum: the torso and knees visibly swell and stiffen as the suit balloons, the fabric pulls tight, the rust-orange harness straps strain and creak, the glove fingers splay apart. Hard sunlight, black background. Slow push-in along the suit. Photorealistic, shot on 35mm film, IMAX documentary realism in the spirit of Apollo 11 (2019) and Gravity. Accurate 1965 Soviet hardware: the white Berkut spacesuit with rust-orange harness straps, a white helmet with red CCCP letters above the visor, Soviet markings only. Hard directional sunlight, deep black space, crisp silhouettes. No on-screen text, no captions.
